patch_description:
Replace the unstructured Gaussian cloud with a deterministic optimization for an antipodal 14-point spherical code.  The construction optimizes seven unit directions and returns each direction together with its antipode.  This fixes the diameter at 2 while the minimum distance is controlled by minimizing the largest absolute inner product between distinct directions.

A batched, reproducible Riemannian soft-minimax search explores many starts cheaply, then applies substantially sharper polishing only to the strongest candidates.  This directly targets the evaluator's squared min/max-distance ratio and implements the suggested adaptive allocation of optimization effort.
